# cycle_pipeline_trigger_key (Resource)

Manages a Cycle pipeline trigger key (`/v1/pipelines/{id}/keys`). Trigger keys authenticate programmatic pipeline runs. The `secret` is returned only at create time; subsequent reads keep the value already stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cycle_pipeline" "deploy" {
  name = "Deploy API"
}

# Trigger keys authenticate programmatic pipeline runs. The secret is
# returned only at create time and is marked sensitive.
resource "cycle_pipeline_trigger_key" "ci" {
  pipeline_id = cycle_pipeline.deploy.id
  name        = "github-actions"
  ips         = ["203.0.113.10"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the trigger key.
- `pipeline_id` (String) The ID of the pipeline this trigger key belongs to. Changing this forces a new trigger key to be created.

### Optional

- `ips` (List of String) An allowlist of IP addresses that may use this trigger key. An empty list means no IP restriction is stored.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this trigger key belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the trigger key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret used when calling the trigger key programmatically. Returned on create; later reads preserve the value from state when the API omits it.
- `state` (String) The current state of the trigger key (e.g. `live`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Trigger keys are imported using the composite ID "pipeline_id/trigger_key_id".
terraform import cycle_pipeline_trigger_key.ci 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21/651f0a88c53f7b6e2c5aa310
```
